title: ExecutionTask
description: Governing schema for human task intent payloads in the Standalone Delegation Layer. Captures human intent only without embedding architectural truth or subject ontology.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for this task instance.

task_kind.description: Data-driven task category defining required authority, allowed changes, outputs, and validators.

target_ref.description: Target git ref: 'DISCOVER_CURRENT' or explicit branch/commit SHA.

curriculum.description: Governing curriculum or examination framework, e.g. CBSE, ICSE, IIT_JEE, IOQM, NEET.

curriculum_version.description: Governing academic year or curriculum version, e.g. 2026-27.

engineering_depth.description: Engineering rigor tier. Architecturally independent of grade, exam name, difficulty, or curriculum classification.

learner_state.description: Cognitive diagnostic state of the learner. Conditions pedagogical support and sequencing; strictly NEVER mutates technical domain truth.

web_research_allowed.description: True if broad open discovery from external sources is permitted. Discovery permission != promotion permission.

local_question_banks.description: Location of local question bank corpora or 'DISCOVER_FROM_REPOSITORY'.

target_consumers.description: Downstream consumers for which readiness is evaluated.

scope_hints.description: Human hints regarding expected subtopic boundaries.
